onlyArbitrage.title: Only arbitrage
onlyArbitrage.description: Only pairs where buying YES on one venue and NO on the other costs less than $1 after fees, with both books quoted on both sides.

minNetReturnPct.title: Minimum net return (%)
minNetReturnPct.description: With Only arbitrage: skip opportunities returning less than this after fees.

venues.title: Venues to compare
venues.description: Which prediction markets to pull and match against each other. Pick at least two. PredictIt is US politics only and publishes no volume figures, so volume filters do not apply to it.

searchQueries.title: Topics / keywords (optional)
searchQueries.description: Only compare markets whose question mentions one of these, e.g. president, minister, Trump, election, Fed, mayor. Works best on named-entity event markets (elections, geopolitics, courts) where the venues list the same yes/no question. Leave empty to compare the most-traded markets on every selected venue.

minSpreadPct.title: Min YES-price gap (percentage points)
minSpreadPct.description: Only return pairs where the two venues' YES prices differ by at least this many points. 0 returns every matched pair; raise it to surface only real gaps (arbitrage-style).

minMatchScore.title: Min match confidence (0-1)
minMatchScore.description: How strict the cross-venue question match must be (token overlap). 0.5 is a good default; raise toward 0.7 for high-precision pairs, lower toward 0.4 for more (noisier) matches.

minKalshiVolume.title: Min Kalshi volume (contracts)
minKalshiVolume.description: Skip Kalshi markets with lifetime volume below this before matching.

minPolymarketVolume24h.title: Min Polymarket 24h volume (USD)
minPolymarketVolume24h.description: Skip Polymarket markets with 24h volume below this before matching.

poolPerVenue.title: Markets scanned per venue
poolPerVenue.description: Markets read per venue before matching. Kalshi lists ~9 markets per event, so 4,000 covers roughly 450 Kalshi events. Up to 10,000.

maxPairs.title: Max matched pairs per run
maxPairs.description: Cap on matched pairs returned. Controls total cost.
